test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e3d1b18d7e0d91551ff61f348cc814af52b3e7957a821e311a259e0a12abc2d.png]
solution:
The logic here is:

All the inner symbols are moving in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/204cc62ed317bfc8b980cf403b436157b9d26dfc6ce556f036497a33f0072791.png] - Moves one step in clockwise direction and another step in anticlockwise direction and this is repeated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ae85e68ca4c4a4ec39cad3fbdcaec2666f74f05b338524c2e5354b020e6789c.png] 

 

Similarly all the symbols which are inside the circle follow this pattern.

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98076af916b9e403d42c24a6fa18f3d683a85d46d95f7bd65688afc51a9745e8.png] - Moves ones step in clockwise direction and as we go ahead the step also increases by one.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52eedaf485c5c7ec350d86d866704d41a966bae5a541427ad5b69231d49a06bb.png] 

Similarly all the letters which are outside the circle follow this pattern.

Thus, the next image will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/061fc2523f9bbb34704d77350ded330603c6d4dcf6d8b0faa0347980315b4e71.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49062ea4fc86ece4ab6367b696e004250ae9c4b08c709b3408b6e105578456b2.png]
